construct: text-decoration-line that VARIES on one enum axis (none at the default value, underline on the other) — the mui.link `underline` shape
why: The declared/keyword door carried UNIFORM values only: a DECLARED_CHANNELS channel whose value is a function of one enum axis was pushed to code-only residue ('declared facts carry uniform values only'), and the compiled variant plane then minted byte-identical cells. MUI Link's whole underline axis died this way — the blind re-grade measured canvas underline-always BYTE-IDENTICAL (md5 14067582) to underline-none while the real library underlines it. The by-axis rescue existed but was hard-scoped to border-*-style by a regex; text-decoration-line is a 'draw'-verdict registry channel and has to reach the canvas as textDecoration = UNDERLINE on that variant.

canvas.note: the underline-always variant compiles with textDecoration UNDERLINE (DECLARED_CHANNELS verdict 'draw'); the default variant keeps none
